dedupeResult: The complete open pull-request patch and repository code index were searched for Fresh On The Net, freshonthenet.co.uk, freshonthe.net, Fresh Faves, Listening Post and Send Us A Track. The Privacy page publishes hello@freshonthe.net for data requests, while the Submit page publishes a personal Gmail address for a conditional Exile FM clean-edit route requiring prior Fresh On The Net submission. Both were source-checked for syntax and purpose but excluded from the canonical submission route. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.
